svg.title: An evening at The Dancing Daisy
svg.desc: A roleplay conversation with light dialogue, purple actions, orange Tell prefixes and grey out-of-character messages. Public speech, emotes with dialogue, private messages, whispers and a shout share one chat log.

g.text: Raih'li Tia says: Welcome to The Dancing Daisy! A table for one?
Legaia Lindblum says: Just me, tonight. *brushes the rain from her coat.*
* Raih'li Tia picks up a menu. "Come in. There's a warm spot by the window."
* Legaia Lindblum follows him inside, her boots leaving little puddles on the floor.
[TELL:Raih'li Tia] Raih'li Tia says: Would you prefer somewhere quieter?
[TELL:Raih'li Tia] Legaia Lindblum says: The window sounds perfect, thank you.
[TELL:Raih'li Tia] * Raih'li Tia sets a menu beside her. "Take your time."
* Legaia Lindblum scans the menu. "The fish and chips, please."
She closes it with a satisfied nod.
Raih'li Tia says: An excellent choice. *jots down the order.* And a drink?
Ziero Aster shouts: Fresh bread! *holds up a basket.* Who wants some?
* Raih'li Tia whispers, "He does this every evening."
* Legaia Lindblum laughs. "Then I'd better try the bread, too."
[TELL:Raih'li Tia] (( Legaia Lindblum: one moment, grabbing some tea! ))
[TELL:Raih'li Tia] (( Raih'li Tia: of course, take your time ))
(( Ziero Aster: thanks for the scene, everyone! ))
